title: woodsia oregana f. pusilla
intro: Woodsia oregana f. pusilla, commonly known as Dwarf Woodsia, is a small to medium-sized fern that belongs to the family Woodsiaceae. It is native to North America and is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Woodsia oregana f. pusilla include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
